scope: Intermediate snapshot, not the final 20-model study
return_definition: 100 * (ending capital / initial capital - 1); net of modeled costs, cumulative, not annualized
interpretation: 7B could call tools in separate access probes but did not attempt research in any of its three complete cycles. Return differences do not establish benefit from library execution. Granite did retrieve through the library; both positive and negative paired results are retained.
ledger: All 440 dated decisions with prior holdings, targets, final statuses, research observations; full daily NAV and executed trades, bound to original hashes. Raw news prose, prompts and response text remain on Beacon.
audit: Recomputed on Slurm using immutable candidate4 source and required exact match with stored independent accounting audit. Zero invalid completed pairs in this snapshot.
field_note: research_error_parse counts failed responses during the research PHASE, which can include an invalid early submit; use tool_usage to distinguish actual research attempts.
